Frequently Asked Questions

QHow do I draw movement arrows on the pitch?

Tap the arrow tool in the bottom toolbar, then drag from any player dot to draw a tactical arrow. You can adjust the curve by dragging the midpoint of the arrow.

QHow do I switch formations?

Tap the formation button (grid icon) in the toolbar and select from 18+ presets. Players will animate to their new positions. You can also drag players manually.

QHow do Kicko's AI suggestions work?

Kicko uses Apple Intelligence running entirely on your device. He analyzes your formation, recent draws, and patterns to suggest tactical adjustments. No internet required for AI features.

QCan I use Soccer Board offline?

Yes. All core features including tactical board, formations, and AI suggestions work completely offline. Internet is only needed for iCloud sync.

QHow do I share a tactical board with my players?

Tap the share icon (top right) and choose to export as image or share via AirDrop, Messages, WhatsApp, etc. Pro users can also export formation animations as video.

QHow do I cancel my Pro subscription?

Go to iPhone Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions > Soccer Board Pro > Cancel Subscription. Your Pro features remain until the end of the current billing period.

QMy data disappeared after updating. What do I do?

Your data is stored locally and in iCloud. Go to Settings > Soccer Board > iCloud Sync and ensure it's enabled. If the issue persists, contact us immediately at support@soccerboard.app.

QIs Soccer Board available on iPad?

Yes! Soccer Board is fully optimized for iPad with a larger pitch canvas. Perfect for presentations in the locker room or on the sideline.
